title: Would rather: another person’s next action
meaningZh: 宁愿某人现在或接下来……
meaningEn: A present or future preference expressed with a past-form clause
explanation: would rather后如果出现另一个从句主语，可以用过去式表达对现在或未来行为的偏好：I would rather the committee published its criteria before it voted。这里published不一定描述过去发生的事，而是拉开语气距离。若前后是同一个主语，通常改用would rather publish，不把两种结构混在一起。
usage: 就他人的下一步安排表达偏好，保留语气距离和具体行动者。
nuance: 偏好并不等于对方已经同意，也不自动构成正式命令。否定置于从句动词前，如would rather you did not decide yet。that可出现也可省略；本课聚焦现在或未来，而不是过去反事实偏好。
structure: would rather + subject + past simple (present/future preference)
would rather + subject + did not + base verb
formation: would rather + subject + past simple (present/future preference)
would rather + subject + did not + base verb

examples.target: I would rather the committee published its criteria before it voted.
examples.zh: 我宁愿委员会在表决前公布标准。

examples.target: We would rather you did not announce a result yet.
examples.zh: 我们希望你暂时不要宣布结果。

examples.target: I would rather discuss the proposal in person.
She would rather the meeting started after six.
examples.zh: 她更希望会议在六点以后开始。

notes: 学习目标：就他人的下一步安排表达偏好，保留语气距离和具体行动者。
等级为教学编排，不代表官方穷尽语法清单。

commonMistakes.wrong: I would rather the committee publishes its criteria tomorrow.
commonMistakes.correct: I would rather the committee published its criteria tomorrow.
commonMistakes.explanation: 对另一个从句主语的现在或未来偏好用过去式表达；tomorrow不要求这里改成现在式。

comparison.explanation: would rather表达偏好，不必带批评；it is high time用过去式催促本应采取的行动，语气更急迫。

exercises.prompt: “I would rather the meeting started after six.” 对started的正确理解是？
acceptedAnswers: 说话者更希望会议六点后开始
exercises.explanation: 过去式在该结构中表达现在或未来偏好，不自动提供过去事件的证据。
options: 会议肯定已在昨天六点后开始
说话者更希望会议六点后开始
会议已被正式取消

exercises.prompt: We would rather you（　）a result yet.
exercises.explanation: 不同从句主语you的否定偏好使用did not加动词原形。
options: not announce
do not announce
did not announce

exercises.prompt: 同一主语I想表达宁愿当面讨论，应选哪句？
acceptedAnswers: I would rather discuss it in person.
exercises.explanation: 同一主语时would rather后接不带to的动词原形；不使用过去式从句。
options: I would rather discuss it in person.
I would rather discussed it in person.
I would rather to discuss it in person.

exercises.prompt: 你偏好委员会明天先公布标准，并不声称它已经这样做。哪句合适？
acceptedAnswers: I would rather the committee published its criteria tomorrow.
exercises.explanation: published在此服务于对未来行为的偏好，tomorrow把时间指向明确保留。
options: I would rather the committee had already published it last year.
I would rather the committee published its criteria tomorrow.
The committee published its criteria yesterday.

exercises.prompt: 参照例句，把“她更希望会议在六点以后开始。”译成英语。
acceptedAnswers: She would rather the meeting started after six.
She would rather that the meeting started after six.
exercises.explanation: 不同从句主语the meeting后用started表达偏好；that可以省略。

title: High time: an overdue change
pattern: it is (high / about) time + subject + past simple
meaningEn: Calling for present action with a past-form clause
explanation: It is time加主语和过去式，可以提出现在该采取的行动；加high通常强调早该做了，带有不满或催促。It is high time we stopped treating every objection as resistance to change并不是说已经停止，而是在要求现在改变。较中性的It is time for us to act则用for加宾语及不定式。
usage: 表达需要立即改变的做法，并识别这种表达中的急迫或批评态度。
nuance: high time可能让人感到被责备，不宜当作始终委婉的请求。过去式是语气距离，不保证动作已完成。about time常暗示终于该做了，具体强度仍取决于语境。
structure: It is time / high time / about time + subject + past simple
It is time for + object + to + base verb (more neutral)
formation: It is time / high time / about time + subject + past simple
It is time for + object + to + base verb (more neutral)

examples.target: It is high time we stopped treating every objection as resistance to change.
examples.zh: 我们早该停止把每个异议都当成抗拒改变了。

examples.target: It is time the council explained its decision.
examples.zh: 是时候让议会解释其决定了。

examples.target: It is about time we reviewed the rules.
examples.zh: 我们也该审查这些规则了。

examples.target: It is time for us to act.
examples.zh: 是我们采取行动的时候了。

notes: 学习目标：表达需要立即改变的做法，并识别这种表达中的急迫或批评态度。
等级为教学编排，不代表官方穷尽语法清单。

commonMistakes.wrong: It is high time we to review the rules.
commonMistakes.correct: It is high time we reviewed the rules.
commonMistakes.explanation: 带主语we的从句使用过去式reviewed；若用to review，应改成it is time for us to review。

comparison.explanation: would rather主要表达行为偏好；high time认为行动已经迟了，可能含批评或催促，不能忽略两者语气差异。

exercises.prompt: “It is high time we reviewed the rules.” 必然意味着什么？
acceptedAnswers: 说话者认为现在早该审查规则了
exercises.explanation: reviewed并不证明已完成，high time表达对当下行动的催促。
options: 审查已在过去完成
规则不能再被审查
说话者认为现在早该审查规则了

exercises.prompt: It is time the council（　）its decision.
exercises.explanation: 带the council作主语时，使用过去式从句。
options: explained
to explain
explaining

exercises.prompt: 你需要较中性的行动建议，而不突出“早该做了”的责备。哪句更合适？
acceptedAnswers: It is time for us to act.
exercises.explanation: for us to act是较中性的结构；另外两句均以high time强调行动迟了。
options: It is high time you finally acted.
It is time for us to act.
It is high time you stopped delaying.

exercises.prompt: 哪句正确使用带主语的high time结构？
acceptedAnswers: It is high time we reviewed the rules.
exercises.explanation: we作从句主语后接过去式reviewed，不能同时拼接for或to不定式结构。
options: It is high time we reviewed the rules.
It is high time we to review the rules.
It is high time for we reviewed the rules.

exercises.prompt: 参照例句，把“是时候让议会解释其决定了。”译成英语。
acceptedAnswers: It is time the council explained its decision.
It is time that the council explained its decision.
exercises.explanation: 用explained表达现在该采取的行动，而非把解释说成已经发生；that可以省略。
